summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Grifols, S.A., a foreign private issuer, reporting its first quarter 2026 financial results. The filing includes a press release and earnings presentation covering revenue growth of 3.3% to €1.7 billion, net profit increase of 21.9% to €73 million, and a successful refinancing of 2027 debt maturities. There are no M&A transactions, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private proposals, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPAC activity, or forced management changes. This is a routine earnings update, not a special situation.
